name: Fukuya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood clothing shop (Sakura Yofukuten): a notice about a sale time change, a first day helping as a shop assistant, a usage guide, a notice about a new senior discount sale, a fitting-day guide, a reflection on talking with customers about their tastes, a report on teaching a new part-time staff member the fitting-room checklist, an essay on why customers grew, a December sale guide, a column on how the role of clothing shops has changed, a notice of revised store operating rules, a reflection on the meaning of time accumulated at a shop, and a one-year cooperation report with a local clothing-recycling network. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
